=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18546-18644 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_extract_standalone_state_json_from_comments` and `_extract_standalone_state_comment_id_from_comments` take the newest comment that contains the `AI_STANDALONE_STALL_STATE_V1` marker without checking who wrote it. `_security_dependency_hold_age_check` then trusts the `security_dependency_depends_on`, `security_dependency_held_since_ts` and `security_dependency_escalated_ts` keys in that comment.
  WHY: Anyone can post a forged state comment with a non-zero `escalated_ts`, which makes line 18723 compute action=none on every tick, so P8c escalation never fires. minimax, glm and gemini also say the PATCH at 18643-18644 hits a 403 that `|| true` hides, causing a write/log loop on every tick. Severities differ: gemini, minimax, luna and glm rate it MAJOR (mapped to high). sonnet rates it NIT with confidence 2 and does not confirm the PATCH loop, saying the repo-scoped GH_PAT can edit any comment in the repository.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18777-18783 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `gh issue edit --add-label "ai:needs-human"` fails, the code only warns. It still writes `security_dependency_escalated_ts` and logs `reason=security_dependency_escalated action=needs_human`.
  WHY: Every later tick sees a non-zero `escalated_ts`, takes action=none at 18723/18727 and never retries the label. The issue stays half-escalated (latch comment, no label), and the log claims a label that was never applied. All reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18751-18758 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dedupe branch only runs when `ai:needs-human` is absent, yet it writes `security_dependency_escalated_ts` and returns without adding `ai:needs-human`.
  WHY: Once `escalated_ts` is non-zero, every later tick takes action=none, so the missing label becomes permanent for the rest of the episode. That is the "held forever with nobody alerted" state P8c is meant to remove. All flagging reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18751-18753 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The latch marker `<!-- ai:needs-human-latch reason=security_dependency_wait depends_on=${depends_on} -->` (body at 18769) is matched with `contains` across the whole comment history and carries no episode identity. Release at 24359-24365 clears the episode keys but leaves the old comment in place.
  WHY: When a new hold opens on the same predecessor, the stale marker triggers the dedupe branch. `escalated_ts` gets written with no new comment and no label, so the new episode is never escalated. Severities differ: gemini, minimax, luna and glm rate it MAJOR (mapped to high); sonnet rates it NIT (confidence 3) because the precondition is uncommon.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18754-18758 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The dedupe branch returns 0 without logging anything, while every other exit from the helper emits a STALL_SKIP reason.
  WHY: An operator reading the poller log cannot tell why a hold older than DEPENDENCY_WAIT_ESCALATE_DAYS was not escalated. Rated NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18760 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_sdh_age_days=$(((_sdh_now - _sdh_held) / 86400))` truncates partial days, so a 7.9-day hold is reported as "waited 7 days".
  WHY: The user-visible latch comment understates the wait by up to a day. minimax adds that the comment promises automatic release even though release requires `DEPENDENCY_WAIT_RESUME_ENABLED=true` (line 24165). Both rate it NIT (mapped to low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The LAST RUN DIFF added an escalation failure path: a failed latch-comment POST logs `STALL_SKIP ... reason=security_dependency_escalation_failed action=none` and returns without labelling or writing state (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18772-18775).
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, near test_security_hold_escalates_once_after_escalate_days / tests covering `_security_dependency_hold_age_check`
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

No `_security_hold_tick` invocation simulates a failed comment POST, although the harness already supports `fail_*` injection.
- requirement: "Escalation records held_since in the existing stall-state comment. Adds ai:needs-human with the dependency chain once per hold episode." The LAST RUN DIFF's dedupe branch writes `security_dependency_escalated_ts` (lines 18756-18757) when a trusted latch marker already exists.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, test_security_hold_escalates_once_after_escalate_days (the "trusted" case, lines 6430-6433)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_extract_standalone_state_json_from_comments (lines 18556-18557) and _extract_standalone_state_comment_id_from_comments (line 18549); _security_dependency_hold_age_check (lines 18714-18727) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both extractors pick the newest state-marker comment without checking `.user.login`. Anyone can post a block with the real depends_on, a past held_since and a non-zero escalated_ts, and line 18723 then gives action=none on every tick. The latch and release markers are trusted only from UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN (18751-18753, 24168-24170). The reviewer does not confirm the PATCH write loop, because the repo-scoped GH_PAT can edit any comment in the repository.
  WHY: A stranger's comment can silently stop P8c escalation. This is a narrow gap in an existing author-agnostic trust model. Fix: add `select((.user.login // "") == $login)` to both extractors, or ignore the security_dependency_* keys unless the author is UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check, lines 18777-18783 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A failed `gh issue edit --add-label "ai:needs-human"` only warns (18778-18779). The code still writes security_dependency_escalated_ts (18781-18782) and logs `reason=security_dependency_escalated action=needs_human` (18783).
  WHY: Once escalated_ts is non-zero, line 18723 blocks every retry, so one transient label failure leaves the issue without ai:needs-human for the whole episode, and the log is wrong. Fix: echo `STALL_SKIP issue=${issue_num} reason=security_dependency_escalation_failed action=none` and `return 0` before the escalated_ts write.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check dedupe branch, lines 18751-18758 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a trusted latch marker exists, the branch writes `security_dependency_escalated_ts: $now` and returns without adding ai:needs-human. The branch is reachable only when the label was never applied: (a) the comment POST succeeded but the response was lost or reported as failed (early return at 18772-18775), or (b) the label edit and the state write both failed (write_standalone_state_json swallows errors at 18644/18647).
  WHY: Before the last run this branch wrote nothing and the next tick retried; now the missing label is permanent. Fix: call `ensure_label_exists "ai:needs-human"`, add the label, and write escalated_ts only on success. The "trusted" test case (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:6430-6433) should seed a non-zero escalated_ts.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:Dedupe marker at lines 18752-18753, latch body at 18769, episode-key removal at 24359-24362 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The latch marker carries no episode identity. If predecessor #M is reopened after release, the new episode finds the old trusted marker and writes escalated_ts with no comment and no label.
  WHY: A re-held follow-up is never escalated again, and the last run made that permanent. Fix: add `held_since=${_sdh_held}` to the marker body and to the dedupe `--arg marker`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:Dedupe branch, lines 18754-18758 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The dedupe branch returns 0 without logging, while every other exit emits a STALL_SKIP reason.
  WHY: An operator cannot tell why an overdue hold was not escalated. Fix: `echo "STALL_SKIP issue=${issue_num} reason=security_dependency_escalated detail=marker_present action=none"`.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: The plan grant lists tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py. The last run added two new escalation failure paths (an early return when the latch POST fails, and an escalated_ts write in the dedupe branch).
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, near test_security_hold_escalates_once_after_escalate_days.
  Evidence of absence: No test makes the latch POST or the label edit fail and then asserts `reason=security_dependency_escalation_failed`, no label, escalated_ts 0 and a retry. The "trusted" dedupe case (lines 6430-6433) does not check the escalated_ts write.
- Note: The reviewer found every linked-issue deliverable in the diff: the env rows in orchestrate_poll.yml, clarify.yml and implement.yml, the security_dependency.py verdict, the poller's aging/escalation/release, latch removal, README rows, the agents.d fragment and the changelog.d fragment.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items): return before the escalated_ts write when the label edit fails (lines 18778-18781, 2 lines); make the dedupe branch call ensure_label_exists and add the label, writing escalated_ts only on success (lines 18754-18758, 5 lines); append held_since=${_sdh_held} to the marker (lines 18752 and 18769, 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
